UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated consultant account anchor document owning private client profiles.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional display name for the signed-in user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last account profile update.

ClientProfile.title: ClientProfile
ClientProfile.description: Private astrology and tarot client profile owned by a signed-in consultant.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the consultant who owns this client profile.

gender.description: Client gender used for classical Ziwei/Bazi chart direction.

birthDate.description: Gregorian birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 short client classification tags (max 32 chars each).

notes.description: Private consultant notes for this client.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when this client profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private consultant root document. Only readable and writable by the authenticated verified owner.

/users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}.description: Private subcollection of client profiles and consultant notes owned by {userId}.
